acceptance_rule: Use locked Folas 4C water parameters and current CPA radial-distribution convention.
Validate SRK-derived pseudo physical parameters against density/phase data; replace with fitted/narrow-cut CPA characterization if justified.
Validate against dodecane/petroleum-cut data; recover Yan narrow-cut method before final acceptance.
Require phase/density validation and chemistry-bracket sensitivity.
Heavy a0/b/c1 are screening values only; must be checked against heavy-cut/residue data.
Start from n-hexane CPA 0.044 and re-fit only to admitted high-T/P raw rows.
Start from n-decane CPA anchor -0.054; do not call it dodecane calibration.
No long-chain extrapolation from C1-C10 correlation; fit to admissible proxy data only.
No tuning for phase appearance or convergence.
Enable only after PNA/aromatic fraction and water-solubility evidence support a mixed-lump solvation representation.
Do not invent association sites/epsilon/beta; consider future polar/nonpolar heavy split.
CPA baseline exists, but binary calibration and Heavy association/physical validation are incomplete.
